nom: TULA Protect + Glow Daily Sunscreen Gel Broad Spectrum SPF 30

avis.texte: Thanks goodness I got this at a discount because after using this within my routine, it was the worse product ever to touch my face. It left my skin greasy, the formula pilled, and there was white cast even though the brand claims it to be gel. Threw it out after half container was used. Hard pass.

The very first use it was chunky and made my skin itch. I thought i just needed to massage the sunscreen more since it was the first use. I gave it another chance and massaged it for a good 10 minutes and NOPE! It was still chunky and left me GREASY. I looked like the peanutbutter baby! And the glitter is horrible! As the day went on it started to peel and when i wiped my face it was could feel it ball up come right off! Do not buy
like the title said, i wanted to love this. it ended up just looking greasy instead of glowy, and it pilled on my skin which is just gross.

I can use most face products without issue. But this stuff has bad texture, and then worst of all it made my skin itch and burn, there's something irritating in it that I must be allergic to. It will also burn eyes and skin around eyes.

avis.titre: I would by this product again and again
avis.texte: This makes my skin soft and protected from the sun! Love this product!

I purchased this when it was on sale during the 21 days of beauty. When I opened it to use it, I thought it was bad because of how lumpy in texture it was, but I read on the package that you have to massage it first (which really doesn't work out the lumps) and when you squeeze it out of the package, it's lumpy and greasy. It feels OK on the skin, but it looks GREASY not glowy!! I wouldn't recommend it over other SPF
I wanted to love this product but it pills almost immediately. It's not worth wearing because it sheds off and takes all of the other products along with it. Do not recommend.

I typicaly have a hard time finding a sunscreen for my face. I don't enjoy feeling like something is sitting on my skin, or makes it feel greasy. This absorbs into my skin and I can't tell I have anything on.

Looked great under makeup but that first squirt of product is definitely going to have separated greasiness but blends out well! Hard to find good production that wont ruin a makeup look so unsure if i would purchase again but definitely still using!

My skin is normal to dry depending on the season. This product fits well in my routine. Cleanse, tone, moisturize, apply Tula sun screen and apply make up. Yes, this sunscreen is glowy. Yes, if you dont allow this product to dry down, it might not work as well. I hate dewy products. And, I likely would not use this product alone. I love the application and non-greasy feel, even after using moisturizer. Ill use another product if I'm going bare faced. Give it a try. I think you'll like it.

As someone who cant stand sunscreen on my face and loves light products, this is absolutely amazing. It doesnt have pore clogging ingredients, is so glowy on the skin, and honestly looks amazing just by itself but even as a base.
I like to use Tula sunscreen because it's light weight and no white residue. Sheer coverage. This is my 5th tube.
Love this! It is lightweight and goes on very smooth. Love the afterglow it gives your skin.

avis.titre: I have been using this for 5+ years
avis.texte: This is the only sunscreen I use that doesnt break me out or clog my pores. It is super light weight but also very hydrating without being greasy. It makes your skin look like you just got a facial. It also works well under any foundation (I rotate between 5-6 different ones). Sunscreen is one of those products I don't skimp out on.

My #1 SPF for over 3 years now. As a skincare girly, I LOVE LOVE LOVE how it makes my skin look. I get complimented all the time on my skin with people telling me it looks like im glowing. Its because of this product right here!!!! Ive never experienced breakouts or redness from it and it really does promote an even complexion which is a plus. However, I do not recommend to use under makeup, but I rarely wear any so its not a problem for me!

I dont like how this feels on my skin. It also is constantly separating when it comes out of the tube. It is very sparkly, like I dusted my face with a bunch of bronzer. I have found better daily SPF options at a cheaper price point.

I use Tula Sunscreen as a backup when Clinique Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion Broad Spectrum SPF 35 is Not in stock at Ulta Beauty Store. I use The Clinique Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion Broad Spectrum SPF 35 as a primer under my makeup. Clinique Products are great for sensitive skin and skin issues like Eczema, Rosacea, Acne. Both products are good for the Winter.
As a redhead I burn easily. I applied this product thoroughly twice in a four hour period and I still got fried. I have another good brand and it lasts all day without reapplying… will not buy again.

avis.titre: How does this product have 4.5 stars
avis.texte: Gosh I love that it has clean ingredients but its like rubbing oatmeal covered in oil on your skin. It just sits like a layer of grease on your face. I want to love because of the clean ingredients but it's just not a usable product.

This product when I first applied it, it feels like cottage cheese (which is fine) just something I noticed. When you rub it it in looks okay(very greesy and shinny) as the day goes on it will start to peel. I would touch my face and the sunscreen would come off on my finger. I bought it on 8/21 and am returning it as I write this on 8/22.

avis.titre: Never had sunscreen burns until now
avis.texte: First time using was on a day i mowed my lawn so i thought maybe that caused the skin around my eyes to sting, burn, dry out & peel. After a weeklong battle to get my skin healthy again, i used this sunscreen again with the same results but worse...burning, stinging, dried skin near my eyes especially but all over my face that will now take at least a week to return to healthy by peeling off. Never again.

This sunscreen has been a repeat for several years now. It's the only sunscreen that doesn't make me look ashy or oily. I have darker skin that is acne prone and this has been my Holy Grail. It gives me a beautiful glow while still offering protection. I love it. I can also use it with make out or alone for a flawless glow. My only con people be the smell, since it's a clean product, I noticed that there is a slight smell to it. Not horrible but it's there. It seems to fade after a while.

This product has become part of my daily routine when I go out. Feels super light on my skin and looks great under makeup. Never have an issue with this sunscreen and this is my fourth time purchasing. Just wish it wasnt so expensive.
I do like this moisturizing sunscreen. Pairs well with all my other products!

This was always my go to. I loved it until recently. Half way through my 3rd bottle and the sunscreen now has a different consistently and is pilling everytime. It's not expired and was not expecting this especially for the price. Won't be repurchasing and would not recommend.

This was always my go to. I loved it until recently. Half way through my 3rd bottle and the sunscreen now has a different consistently and is pilling everytime. It's not expired and was not expecting this especially for the price. Won't be repurchasing and would not recommend.

Tula made a sunscreen serum that was fantastic! Best i ever used. They stopped making it this year so i switched over to this one. Its nothing like the serum! This is heavy, greasy and causes breakouts. It also has a strong smell. Please Bring the serum back!
Got this from FabFitFun! I love this sunscreen - for the brown girlies! This leaves no white cast, smells like bananas, very tropical and leaves your skin with a beautiful glow.
This is my favorite daily spf. I've received a lot of compliments about my skin when I use this product. My only wish for this item is that it would come in a stronger spf. An spf 50 would be ideal!
This is not gel! This is oily and chunky and awful. Do NOT buy and waste your money. First time I've been disappointed by Tula.
This is such an amazing product! Its so glowy, moisyering amd it has SPF (which is your BFF) i hibetsly think it coulc work fir every skin type. It is worth EVERY CENT.

really really wanted to like this one but the eye burn was horrible. other than that I really liked how it was moisturizing but it wasn't tacky. I live in a humid climate and even though I generally have dry skin, a lot of moisturizing products feel tacky in the humidity. This stuff dried down beautifully and still left a glow. BUT THE EYE BURN T_T
I was debating between the supergoop sunscreen and this one and I love how hydrating and glowy this sunscreen made my skin look. It's on the dewier side but with setting powder it looks great.

avis.titre: This sunscreen protects and makes me glow
avis.texte: I really like this sunscreen, I am out in harsh weather and find that I don't burn (I reapply every 2 hours.) It leaves me with a light glow which I really like. I don't wear makeup so I'm not sure how it sits under foundation.
I love all Tula but unfortunately, this pills on my skin & it separates in the bottle so I've got to shake it and I lose some product each application.
I love this product. When you apply it, it adds a glow to your skin. The only downside is it is only a 30 SPF. Isiah it had the option of getting a stronger one.

avis.titre: Itchy Red Bumps All Over Face
avis.texte: I was looking for a new sunscreen and decided to give this a try because other Tula products have worked for me in the past. This sunscreen gave me small red itchy bumps all over my face. My skin looks horrible now!
I wanted so badly to love this because i really like the brand. However, the formula is chunky and oily (like a lava lamp). Then once i applied it, my skin was peeling, dry and just gross.

This product smells so good and really works I apply it once a day and it last all day never feels greasy or heavy and smells great not like you're lathered in coconut like some sunscreens or smell like zinc oxide It has a clean smell and feels great going on I use it everyday right after my moisturizer

avis.titre: Light and great for sensitive skin
avis.texte: This is my favorite sunscreens for my face. It is light and leaves a glowy look and doesn't make my face sticky like most do. I love it under any Tula product or other makeup. A little goes a long way and it's something I recommend for anyone with sensitive skin!
I really like this sunscreen. It isn't greasy at all and absorbs well, plus leaves your skin feeling soft. I also like that it gives your skin a nice glow!

I use this everyday over the summer! I love the flow that it give and it keeps my face clear. I'm giving 4 stars because I'd love for this to be fragrance free. The smell is okay, just not something I'd like on my face all day. Overall, it's definitely a great product and I'll continue to use it.

I have been using tula products for more than 2 years now, but this product made me break out so bad! My entire face is full of acne but this does not ends here! READ THE INGREDIANTS VERY CAREFULLY! It is very harmfull which is not even safe for skin! Please save your skin!
I've been using this sunscreen moisturizer for a long time. It feels so good & provides sunscreen before I put on foundation of any kind on my face. I hope it's never discontinued.

On my 3rd tube and it's my favorite sunscreen. I love the sheen to it as it instantly brightens my face for a nice glow. I love wearing it without makeup over top because the sheen is beautiful. I live in Arizona so this has prevented sunburn during 9 months of the year.

This is the one product I never let myself run out of. I have seen such a huge improvement in my skin since I've been using it (over 3 years now!). I love how it gives my skin a dewy, natural glow—I get compliments often on how healthy my skin looks, and this is the only product I've used consistently for years now. Love love love it

Love, love, love this sunscreen! I'm 43 and it gives me a little glow and protects all day. I even use it when I'm not leaving the house because the blue rays from the computer and helps me look more youthful on those video calls ;)

Though this product gives a pretty decent glow, I feel it's more greasy than "dewy". I experience peeling with every single use which I find the most disappointing aspect. Even though I love that it's one if the few suncare products that does not leave a white cast, that's wasn't enough to make me love this product. I don't see myself purchasing this again once it runs out.
Provides sun protection while giving me a nice dewy glow. It blends well on my skin. Love this product.
I really love this spf. It looks great under makeup or just bare skin.

Let me paint a picture… I'm 45, been using this product for 5 years.. I've had acne prone skin for my entire life, so sometimes massive shiny skin emphasizes the size of these pores and accentuates my scarring, yes I have TERRIBLE acne scars.. but this product! Lemme tell you, It makes me feel my very best the moment I put it on my face, and neck. The perfect glow, and ZERO brake outs. This is by far the greatest dewy, shine bright like a diamond, moisturizer I've ever used! And I stand 10 toes down on every word i just wrote. Give this a try!!! If I doesn't work, y'all can return it.
The best sunscreen ever! You can ever just wear it alone and it gives you a natural glow and is so good for your skin. I highly recommend this product!

avis.titre: My go to ever day must have!!!
avis.texte: By far the best sunscreen! Not greasy, leaves your skin glowing and is amazing to use under makeup

I came across Tula roughly 4 years ago when I relocated to Houston, TX and I haven't stopped using it since! This is by far my favorite product, it's very light weight, protects your skin, and provides your face with a glow! I don't think I'll use another sunscreen product. Thank you Tula!

I LOVE this sunscreen. I can't find my favorite Bare Republic SPF 30 Face Sunscreen anywhere anymore and have been looking for something just like it-lightweight and NO greasy or oily feeling. Nothing else I've tried has even come close. I only deducted a star because way overpriced.

avis.titre: Have used this product for several years now.
avis.texte: I have been buying this product for several years now. Every time I have it on I get compliments on the glow of my skin. It even has SPF 30, which is a great feature. Even the nurse in my dermatologist office asked me what I was wearing and complemented me.

I use several different Tula products and this is one of my favorites. This sunscreen is incredible and it works! Little bit goes a long way so it lasts for forever. Super lightweight and breathable. Highly recommend this product and every Tula product.
BEST DAILY FACE SUNSCREEN ON THE MARKET. PERIOD. This is one of my favorite Tula products. Worth every penny. Highly recommend.
Love this sunscreen! Best I've ever used Lasted all day Didn't have to reapply even when laying in my pool for hours!

I wanted to love it. The price point was what sold me so, I decided to give it a try this summer. I had never used a gel sunscreen and it just didn't work for me. It doesn't go on well with makeup. The end result ends up looking like your face is peeling.
its a little pricey and it's personaly too glowy for me, but overall its a great product!
If you like glowy luminous skin and sunscreen that doenst feel like sunscreek then you will love this. I know I do. I've been using this now for about two years. It's one of my favorites.
Kinda grainy and greasy and too warm a tone. I love several Tula products, but this was not one for me. But the couple times I used it, it didn't seem to irritate my skin.

This is the only sunscreen I will ever let touch my face, and the face of my two kids. I love how glowy it makes you, I love how easily it soaks into my skin, and my eyes do not get irritated. That's why I have jumbo size on auto delivery. Best!!
Works great and leaves my skin feeling moisturized. Kinda funny smelling but it dissipates after a few minutes.

this sunscreen has a lot of pros, skincare and the dewy glow it gives while being super lightweight. i have super sensitive skin and could barley tolerate this most days becsuse of how much it would sting and burn or make my skin breakout in a rash. some days i could tolerate it but most says i couldnt, i swear it made me burn more when i took it to the beach. just beware if you put sunscreen on your neck chest and face and dont wear any AHA/BHA/or chemical exfoliants your skin will breakout. this is for ppl w a great skin barrier
I use tula products since forever! Was very excited to try this! But it made my skin so bad and sadly I have pimples all over my cheeks :(
I just love this product!!! Honestly my face feels so silky and moisturized,
This is by far my favorite face sunscreen to use. It gives you a great glowy look without looking greasy and it doesn't clog my pores causing unwanted breakouts.

If you want to glow that will compete with the sunshine, you found it. It's a nice lotion that applies easy. Give it several minutes to dry down before you continue with your make up routine. It has nice broad spectrum protection. Now as I like some glow products because they add a little illumination from within Under your make up, this one was pretty glowy. I didn't need highlighter. In fact, I needed a little bit of modifying powder to tone it down a bit in areas. I didn't want that much glow. If you want to make your matte finish blush have a little more luminosity, this will give a nice base for that effect.

avis.titre: A MUST for my morning routine!
avis.texte: I put this on every morning before I leave the house and LOVE it!!! It gives my face a nice glow without the look and feel of greasy skin. It's a must for my morning skincare routine!!
ive tecently started this and it is now my fvsorite prinerr is not inly primes but makes your skin glow
I love this sunscreen! It goes on so smoothly and adds a little glow to your every day look. It doesn't make you feel greasy or anything throughout the day. I will be buying again (& again!)

The fact that this has UVA and UVB protection is so huge. I wear this hiking, paddle boarding, at work, etc. and never get burnt. This sunscreen does leave a nice dew, however, you do need to caution against using too much product bc then you might look a lottle greasy and may get a little pilling. Unless they substantially change the formula, this will be a product i always make sure I have plenty of.
I have been using this for years! I love the moisture and glow it gives.
I am a repeat purchaser. Love how this goes on. Lightweight protection.
The best everyday sunscreen, adds a nice glow and shimmer and keeps the skin protected in the az sun
Love it. Makes your face llook and feel dewy. Can wear alone or with makeup
Daily sunscreen I've purchased this previously and it's the only one I will apply to my skin
Love this sunscreen so very much!!!!! I've been using it for the last few years!!! Makes me glow!
This is as advertised. Feels good going on. Not greasy. I use alone or under makeup. Definitely massage the tube before using.
Maybe ok for oily skin but this makes my dry skin SO dry and tight. Yuck.

I have tried many face sunscreens. A lot of them would burn my sensitive skin and make my eyes water, make my skin red, or leave a white cast. This stuff does none of those things! It doesnt even feel like Im wearing sunscreen, nor does it smell like sunscreen! It gives a beautiful, radiant glow to your skin. I get compliments all the time saying "wow your skin looks so good!" and "you have such a glow!" I used to be self conscious of my uneven, reddish skin tone and would only feel confident if I was wearing foundation or BB cream. Now i have ditched those products, and feel completely confident wearing only this product out because it gives such a radiant glow (its not sparkly, either). I have almost finished the jumbo bottle and plan to buy another one when all Tula products go on sale for 25% off on Sunday, which helps because it's pricey. Highly recommend!
Such a great sunscreen! So light weight and not greasy , lays great under makeup . This is great on my sensitive skin
My go to sunscreen! Goes on so smooth and feels light in your face, not greasy feeling at all! No breakout from using it as someone who has sensitive skin! Highly recommend it!
Noticeable changes to my skin within days plus a glow. Bought 2-3 times // fave!

I absolutely love this facial sunscreen. My first one came in A subscription box and I fell in love with it. Had to buy some more this year It's very light. It goes along way. And it leaves your face glowing. Don't use too much or you'll be over-glowing!
Different feel like sunscreen when you put it on. Very lightweight. Minimal smell. Overall 8/10

The daily sunscreen gel (SPF 30) works very well!! I was at the beach the first day I wore it & no burn at all. It is light weight, non-greasy & gives a nice little glow to the skin. Feels good on so easy to wear every day!

I absolutely LOVE this sunscreen! I first purchased it two years ago and its now a staple in my skincare routine. I used to have dry skin and now have a bit more oily skin as my skin has changed a bit and it still works wonderfully. It leaves the most beautiful glow to your skin 💛
Makes my skin so soft and bright! I love the glow it leaves. Not greasy at all like other sun screens!
Amazing sunscreen , very light weight and not greasy ! Have to try if you have sensitive skin !

avis.titre: Wish I Had Found it Years Earlier...
avis.texte: My GO-TO all year round with or without make-up. I adore the slight healthy sheen it provides. As an avid gardener it's a staple in my daily routine.
I have been using this Tula sunscreen for years it gives your skin a very nice glow meanwhile by also protecting your skin. As someone with melanin skin I recommend Tula sunscreen.
THE BEST SUNSCREEN EVER! Use it daily on my face and shoulders and chest. Just repurchased the big size for the 3rd time!
Love this product. Not only does it protect your skin from the sun but gives you a radiant glow.
